input: M1 37 future-pulse target events x4 cells; target first 1Ah and previous same-temperature full pulses only
signal: apparent 10s voltage drop/current, not pure ohmic resistance
baseline: M1 last same-temperature curve shifted by target 0.2-1Ah median
correction: previous-to-target apparent R10s difference times (1-exp(-(q-1)/2Ah)); coefficient ridge fitted only on earlier complete target events
negative_control: rotate each target's cell-specific deltaR to another cell while keeping its target voltage
selection_limit: TU 8S 160Ah step R model is not directly transferred to official 4S 102Ah pulse due SOC/current/rate/temperature mismatch; test official signal itself as an auxiliary channel only
claim: future voltage information, never CK1-CK7 capacity accuracy
